scope: Engine enroll path for SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL — focus: bean-cycle safety, no duplicated backstops, exhaustive switch, Outcome.COMPLETE correctness.
summary: Implementation is correct and idiomatic to the existing funnel module. The SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL case rides the pre-existing StepExecutor -> FunnelEventService edge (no new injection of the factory/engine/FunnelService into StepExecutor), so no bean cycle is introduced. Backstops (depth-cap, auto-enroll rate-limit) reuse the existing maxEnrollDepth field and the private autoEnrollRateLimitExceeded method rather than forking new ones. The exhaustive return-switch in StepExecutor.execute now covers SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL; Outcome.COMPLETE was added to the enum and an explicit case COMPLETE branch was added to the drive switch STATEMENT (which the compiler does NOT enforce), calling the existing claim-conditional complete(exec, now) and returning. No findings requiring code changes.

findings.finding: subscribeToFunnel calls the already-injected funnelEventService; no FunnelExecutionFactory/FunnelExecutionEngine/FunnelService injection added. The enroll uses the existing StepExecutor -> FunnelEventService edge and FunnelEventService -> FunnelExecutionFactory edge, neither of which edges back into the engine. No new cycle is possible.

enrollSpecificFunnel reuses maxEnrollDepth and the private autoEnrollRateLimitExceeded (same Redis key bf:rate:auto-enroll:, fail-open) — no second/forked limit. Order mirrors dispatchForSubscriber: depth-cap -> rate-limit -> resolve+fail-closed projectId -> active-check -> entry-step fallback WARN -> re-enter/factory. The single-dispatcher-owns-backstops invariant holds.

drive is a switch STATEMENT, so a missing case COMPLETE would silently no-op (leaving the row in_progress). The branch was added explicitly and is terminal (calls complete(exec, now) then returns), matching CANCEL/FAIL structure. complete() is claim-conditional (stillClaimed CAS), preserving the concurrent-cancel-wins invariant. No further steps execute after COMPLETE.

insertExecution is now a thin delegate to insertExecutionAt(..., null); the body is not duplicated. resolveStartCursor returns startStepId only when it resolves in the snapshot, else step 0 (or null for empty) — preserving the legacy step-0 fallback for the 5 unchanged callsites. MongoTemplate.insert and LOG_EXECUTION_STARTED retained.

Whole method wrapped in try/catch(Throwable) with a greppable LOG_ENROLL_ERROR (exception class only). Each skip reason has its own distinct greppable id. Logs carry only ids/codes/enum-status — no subscriber field or target name (Decision 16, anti-log-injection).
